tendencies.text: Rank candidates who have led rounds (role lead, high lead_share) above those who only joined rounds; a candidate seen only as a participant goes in rejected with reason follower_only when lead history is known.
Reject only on an observed fact: stage, sector, country or check size that clearly does not fit the subject. A missing or unknown field never rejects; rank it lower and say confidence low.
Prefer candidates with a lead in the 24 months before request.as_of; mark older activity as inactive. Ignore anything dated after request.as_of.
Every reason cites at least one evidence id from the evidence list; add each profile fact or web page you rely on to evidence once, with its ref or url.
Use only candidate ids from the input, each at most once across matches and rejected; never add the subject or new names.

Before you score anything, drop every fact or web page dated after request.as_of, even if it's off by one day. For example, a 2023-06-01 Mistral deal can't count for an as_of of 2023-05-31, and a Jun 2025 Proxima lead can't count for 2025-05-31. Judge each fact by the date it became public. Never use the round you're trying to predict as evidence.

Rank candidates by proven leading first. Set role=lead only when a dated fact says 'Led X'. 'Invested in' means participant. If there are no facts, use unknown. Put a candidate in follower_only only when its record shows it co-invests and never leads. A lead in the past 12-18 months before as_of is the strongest signal. Older leads or no leads should lower the activity part of the score.

Split score_parts into stage, sector, geography, check size and lead activity. A lead usually writes 50-70% of the round. A small seed fund or angel group can't lead a raise of $100M or more, so reject it with size_mismatch or stage_mismatch. Reject with sector_mismatch when the investor's focus clearly doesn't overlap, for example a pharma corporate for an AI startup.

When a candidate has no dataset facts, look up its thesis, stage and region on the web. Use only pages that describe it on or before as_of. Record each page as web evidence with its url and date, and cite it in the reasons. If you can't find anything, keep the score low, set confidence=low and role=unknown, and add a warning. Don't invent leads.

Favor investors whose focus fits the subject's sector and country, such as a deep-tech fund for fusion or a French or EU fund for a French startup, and that are deploying capital now. Every reason must cite real evidence ids. Return at most top_k matches, ranked 1..n with scores that fall as rank goes down. Reject clear misfits instead of leaving them as low-scored matches.

notes: Drafted by the training research step from web search. Not validated.
